seatedToss.guidance: Sit at a table and take turns tossing a soft bean bag into the big target. Keep the tally on paper, together.
steps: Print the target and tally sheet, and lay it flat on the table between you.
Sit comfortably, one on each side. Take turns with one gentle toss each, or pass if you would rather not.
When a toss lands in a ring, the person who tossed ticks one box in their column, on the row for that ring.
Look at the ticks together when you stop, if you like. Nobody has to add anything up.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Use only a bag with a sewn-shut cover or a rolled-up sock, stay seated, never toss toward a face, and keep an adult nearby. Small parts are a choking hazard.
safety: Choose a bean bag with a sewn-shut cover, or roll up a clean sock. Check it first for holes or loose stitches, so no filling can come out.
Beans, rice and other small fillings are a choking hazard. Keep them away from young children and from anyone who puts things in their mouth.
Stay within arm's reach and supervise closely if anything might be put in the mouth.
Stay seated. Toss gently and low toward the target on the table, never toward a face.
seatedToss.previewLabel: The printed sheet: a target of three rings named Near, Middle and Far, from the outside in, and a tally with a column for each person and a row of empty boxes for each ring.
seatedToss.sheetHow: Lay the sheet flat between you. When a toss lands in a ring, tick a box in your column, on that ring's row.

decorateACard.guidance: Choose an occasion, then decorate a card together with crayons or pens. There is no right card.
decorateACard.stepsHeading: Ɗum ɗon ɓaɓɓe kaɗɗe e ɗo ɗo

steps.fold: Print the card and fold it in half along the dashed line, so the front is on the outside.
steps.front: One person decorates the front, around the words.
steps.inside: The other person decorates the back, or you take turns on one side.
steps.message: Write a message together. One person can write while the other says the words.
steps.stop: Stop whenever you like. There is no right card, and a simple one is just as good.

decorateACard.materials: Use crayons, colored pencils or felt-tip pens. Nothing needs cutting, gluing or sticking.

drawingDuet.guidance: Gaɗɗu ɗuuɗi, kala jaɓɓo e ɗorde fuɗɗo, sey gaɗɗu kalam. Jaɓɓo fof mbaɗa gaɗɗe. Alaa ko winndete ɗo. Nanndo ngoodu ɗo ɗon ɗaɓɓaŋ ko onon winndi ɗum.
drawingDuet.keys: Kulle ngarɗe ɗon ɗuula teeɗe kalam e nanndo. Ɓaawo ɗon waɗa wala ɗon tiiɗa kalam.
drawingDuet.tookBack: Ɗorde ɗon ngoodi ɗo {person|lower} ngoodi ɗon ƴamaaɗi.
drawingDuet.restarted: Nanndo ɗon wala. Jaɓɓo fuɗɗo ɗon ɗuuɗi. Sooɗu ɗum, sey onon yiɗaa wala.
drawingDuet.restored: Ɗorde ɗon sooɗaa haa ɗe ngoodi.
drawingDuet.saved: Nanndo maa ɗon ngoodi. Ɗaɓɓu linkaaɗo ngam ɗum ngam ɗum ɓanndu e ɗum ɗon ngoodi.
drawingDuet.paperRules: Jaɓɓo ɗiɗo, nanndo fuɗɗo, kalam ɗiɗo. Ɗuuɗi: kala jaɓɓo ɗorde wala kuutol fuɗɗo, sey gaɗɗu kalam. Jaɓɓo fof mbaɗa gaɗɗe. Alaa nanndo ngoodu ɗo ɗon ngalu.

colorWash.guidance: Winndu koloor ɗo ɗo ɗee ɗe nanndo, kala hannde fuɗɗo. Tiiɗu burus ngam tawtaa, e taw ɗo yiɗi. Alaa ko ɓinndete wala ɗo ɗaɓɓete.
colorWash.keys: Kulle ngarɗe ɗon ɗuula ɓaawo burus e nanndo. Ɓaawo ɗon waɗa wala ɗon tiiɗa burus.
